exposure: 8 women who had cesarean delivery due to failure of labor progression
32 matched controls who had vaginal delivery
Hiatal area during levator ani muscle contraction
hiatal area during levator ani muscle contraction
outcome: Mode of delivery (cesarean section vs. vaginal delivery)
finding: A smaller hiatal area, measured by transperineal ultrasound in the first trimester and at the end of pregnancy, was associated with an increased likelihood of cesarean delivery due to failure of labor progression.
mod_finding: Women with a smaller hiatal area were more likely to have a cesarean delivery.
gest_age: First trimester and 34-36 weeks of gestation
